description: Defines the EffectiveConnectionType enum and related functions for network connection quality assessment in the net namespace.

classes.name: EffectiveConnectionType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different levels of network connection quality.

methods.name: GetNameForEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the string name corresponding to an EffectiveConnectionType enum value.

methods.name: GetEffectiveConnectionTypeForName
methods.description: Returns the EffectiveConnectionType enum value for a given connection type name, or unset if unknown.

methods.name: DeprecatedGetNameForEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Deprecated function to get string name for an EffectiveConnectionType.
